Darkshore Grouper is edible and Raw Plated Armorfish is a current Cooking reagent, so both qualify despite quest associations.

limits: Reference-complete within inspected sources and selected scope; not a claim that the live Forever server has no undocumented catches.
No Forever loot table or measured exact server skill thresholds are publicly exposed by these sources.
Zephras Isle catches use published player observations; skills remain unverified.
Riverglades player-supplied possibilities remain unverified, not established catches.
Raw Spinefin Halibut has a current cooking recipe but no supported fishing source; world/vendor sources are not promoted to fishing locations.
Named waters inherit their parent skill only when no explicit subzone base exists. Jademir Lake, Jaguero Isle, Bay of Storms, Hetaera's Clutch and Scalebeard's Cave retain explicit higher bases.
The old audit incorrectly associated area 1039 with Westfall; the named hierarchy identifies The Lost Fleet in Wetlands. Expansion uses the correct hierarchy.
